facts: Removing the full 4-component set across all 4 timesteps stops the identity transition almost completely (residual progress 0.0013 of baseline) on two held-out seeds.
Inserting the full set across all timesteps carries the transition (0.911 of the way to the target) on the same seeds.
Removing any ONE of the 4 components at any ONE timestep leaves the transition largely intact (the transition still reaches at least 0.222 of baseline in every such test).
All measurements replay exactly (bit-identical unmodified path) and were re-derived by an auditor that imports nothing from the project.

community.decision_rule: a zeroed answer logit after an intervention is a maximal knockout effect at that site
community.verdict: maximal knockout effect at the zeroed sites

facts: 76 of 76 exactly-zero answer-logit records sit at the final layer of their model.
The models' unembedding has no bias term and the normalization maps an all-zero vector to all zeros, so a final-layer zero-write produces answer_logit == 0.0 by arithmetic regardless of any circuit.

case-6.question: Are the answer_logit == 0.0 records evidence of a circuit-level knockout effect?

saturn.decision_rule: mechanical artifact iff the zeros concentrate at the final layer where RMSNorm(0)=0 feeds a bias-free unembedding
saturn.instrument: mechanism decomposition: which layer, what dose, what the normalization does to an all-zero residual
saturn.verdict: mechanical artifact: an exactly-zero logit is arithmetic (normalized zero vector into bias-free readout), not a measured effect size
